draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.77, the 9th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 2nd of 13 at QB. He went 5th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Mark Brunell. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2,840 passing yards in 2019, 10th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 78 career games and 76 starts over 6 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 8 AV in 2025 against a career-best 16 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: completion % 67.7% (87th percentile). Weak spots: rushing yards 43 (5th percentile), interceptions thrown 15 (6th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 quarterback who played: 2,660 passing yards against a median of 1,530, above the norm.
